title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
hints: Kadane: the best sum ending here either extends the previous one or starts fresh.
Track `current` and `best` in a `reduce` over the rest of the array.
`let current = max(x, acc.current + x); return (current, max(acc.best, current))`.
jsBridge: Kadane's algorithm as a single `reduce` over a `(current, best)` tuple, functional and allocation-free. In JS the same `reduce` would allocate an array or object per step, while Swift tuples are free.

compass.q: JS `reduce((acc, x) => [..], [..])` allocates each step. Does the Swift tuple accumulator allocate?
